purpose: Initial-model exploratory TRAINING only; no validation acceptance or automatic calibration.
priorExploratorySeeds: 0..11 belong to training and are not independent validation
runtime: actual CreateStochasticBotRace settings factory; controller slot 1; loop stops at bot terminal; no state injection or full observer replay
errorPolicy: Retain every announced case, every terminal status, and every error; no reroll/filter. Continue remaining cases after case error. A metric lacking any announced observation has null aggregate/CI. Fatal interruption records completed cases and all unrun IDs.
confidenceMethod: Exploratory two-sided 99% Student-t mean interval: sample SD (n-1), n=200, conservative critical value 2.601 (df=199, rounded upward). No familywise or validation acceptance claim; missing data never silently reduces n.
parameterPolicy: CreateInitial only; all 50 parameter rows hashed before cohort. No online adaptation, quotas, fixed calibration table or held-out execution.
outputOrder: track order above, then profile order, difficulty order, ascending seed; independent of worker completion order
publication: Unique Release binary directory with immutable source snapshots, configuration and manifest hashes before training. No recompilation during cohort. Working-tree changes do not substitute the published assembly.
